test_name: Verify Pagination Functionality in Test Suites Table
description: This scenario tests the ability of users to navigate through the paginated test suite table using pagination controls.
steps: Navigate to the Test Suites page.
Verify the visibility of pagination controls at the bottom of the table.
Click on the '2' button to navigate to page 2.
Verify that the table updates to display test suites from page 2.
Click on the 'Next' button to navigate to page 3.
Verify that the table updates to display test suites from page 3.
Click on the 'Last' button to navigate to the last page.
Verify the table updates to display test suites from the last page.
Click the 'First' button to navigate back to the first page.
Verify the table updates to display test suites from the first page.
expected_results: Table updates correctly based on the selected page.
Pagination controls navigate between pages as expected.
edge_cases: Clicking 'Next' on the last page does nothing.
Clicking 'Previous' on the first page does nothing.
Rapid clicking of pagination buttons causes UI glitches.
Pagination buttons are disabled due to backend errors.
data_requirements: Test suites data spanning multiple pages.
Total count of test suites for pagination calculations.
User permissions to view test suites.
dependencies: Correct implementation of pagination in the backend.
Functional pagination controls in the UI.
Stable database with test suite entries.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load a new page.
Smoothness of UI transitions between pages.
accessibility_requirements: Pagination buttons must have aria-label attributes.
